# Ezekiel 22 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 22:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Father and-mother they-treated-with-contempt in-you; the-sojourner they-oppressed in-your-midst; the-orphan and-the-widow they-wronged in-you. |
| LOGOS | Father and mother are treated with contempt in you; the sojourner suffers extortion in your midst; the fatherless and the widow are wronged in you. |
| PNEUMA | Fathers and mothers are treated with contempt. Foreigners are exploited. Orphans and widows are cheated. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 22:23 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | And the word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | The LORD spoke to me again: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 22:4 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-your-blood which you-shed you-have-become-guilty, and-in-your-idols which you-made you-have-become-unclean, and-you-have-brought-near your-days, and-you-have-come to your-years; therefore I-have-made-you a-reproach to-the-nations and-a-mockery to-all the-lands. |
| LOGOS | You have become guilty by the blood that you have shed, and defiled by the idols that you have made, and you have brought your days near, and the appointed time of your years has come. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all the countries. |
| PNEUMA | You are guilty because of the blood you've shed. You are defiled by the idols you've made. You've brought your day of judgment closer. Your time has run out. That's why I've made you an object of scorn and ridicule to every nation. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 22:26 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Her-priests have-violated My-law and-profaned My-holy-things; between the-holy and-the-common they-have-not-distinguished, and-between the-unclean and-the-clean they-have-not-made-known; and-from-My-Sabbaths they-hid their-eyes, and-I-am-profaned in-their-midst. |
| LOGOS | Her priests have done violence to My law and have profaned My holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they taught the difference between the unclean and the clean, and they have disregarded My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them. |
| PNEUMA | The priests have violated My law and desecrated My holy things. They don't distinguish between what is sacred and what is ordinary, or between what is clean and unclean. They ignore My Sabbaths, and I am dishonored among them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 22:30 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-sought from-among-them a-man [who would]-build-up a-wall and-stand in-the-breach before-Me on-behalf-of the-land, so-that I-would-not-destroy-it; but-I-found-none. |
| LOGOS | And I sought for a man among them who should build up the wall and stand in the breach before Me for the land, that I should not destroy it, but I found none. |
| PNEUMA | I looked for someone among them who would repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so I wouldn't have to destroy it. But I found no one. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 22:8 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst. |
| LOGOS | You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst. |
| PNEUMA | You despise what is holy and violate My Sabbaths. Slanderers among you stir up bloodshed. People feast at pagan shrines and commit obscene acts throughout the city. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
